notes.title: Kalinur is Coming!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25105419/b7241f282030181f8404dd98168c3d32fc1bbb4a.png[/img]
Hello ORCS!

Coming here to announce Kalinur, my new game.

Kalinur is a mini metroidvania inspired by games like Hydra Castle Labyrinth and Castle in the Darkness with an excellent price and an incredible discount at the launch week.

Wishlist it now and help me to bring more fun games.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2085800/Kalinur/
